purpose: Review the four previously fixed growth-target and ceiling views on archived v13 economic outcomes; distinguish attainable objectives, score saturation and sources of asset growth.

views.legacy: Original country goals and linear cap at goal.
views.targets: Frozen v12 country goals and linear cap at goal.
views.headroom: Original goals; 80% of growth component at goal, 100% at twice goal.

no_changes: Economic production, prices, raw requirements, starting conditions and investment rules
Growth metrics including asset and utilization definitions
Frozen goals, score curves, weights and benchmark selection
AI actions or adaptation to the alternative scores
analysis_status: Posthoc review of already inspected archived outcomes using previously frozen views. Not a fresh independent simulation or a score-aware policy experiment.

cohorts.other_modes: All other four economic modes kept separately as sensitivity checks.
cohorts.behavior_controls: Use same mode and stress seed normal control, 30 seeds; do not pair with main100.
cohorts.pilot: Rescore and verify lineage only; never combine with formal summaries or claim independent holdout.

summary_metrics: Mean total and six score contributions (economic growth, reserve, capacity, utilization, wellbeing, trade)
Economic-growth and capacity at-cap and >=95% near-cap frequencies
Existing relative +5% growth sensitivities, with zero-growth limitation identified
Arithmetic-only +10G asset-gain and +0.10 capacity-growth sensitivity; not feasible game actions
Original-six top-score counts with ties and 1e-9 tolerance
Mean of per-game original-six max-minus-min score ranges, separate from range of country means
Same-record view differences and 2x2 view interaction

behavior_scope.minimum_idle: Original six each, all six economic modes, same stress seeds.
behavior_scope.cheap: Technia only; existing public half-reference pricing scenario.
behavior_scope.invest_trade: Mineria and Technia only; no claims for the other four countries.
behavior_scope.compound: Rescore all archived compound and mixed cases; compare only available same-seed controls.
behavior_scope.no_trade: Archived zero-trade scenario, never fabricate a new control.

behavior_diagnostics: Total and six score contribution paired deltas with mean, approximate 95% interval, up/tie/down counts
Idle asset gain > normal; economic component > normal; total score > normal counted separately
Investment rises and actual use fails to rise while score rises: review flag, not automatic proof of waste or a bug
Minimum-price and half-price score exceptions retained and explained, not tuned away
asset_identity: asset_gain = cash_sales - cash_purchases + automatic_operating_income - 0.55*investment + (end_stock_value - start_stock_value); start_stock_value = start_asset_value - start_cash. This decomposes the existing metric without replacing it.

structural_capacity_review.type: Exhaustive dynamic enumeration of relaxed industrial-level states, not economic games.
structural_capacity_review.expansion: Only the configured expansion good, starting in round3; original owned industries remain available.
structural_capacity_review.capacity: Existing fixed-base-price weighted base production; food gains two base units per level, other goods one.
outputs: Maximum capacity growth upper bound with witness
First attainable growth at or above each frozen goal and full-score threshold
Minimum successful investments lower bound for those thresholds
Raw percentile vs rounded goal threshold crossings
Impossible full-capacity score if threshold exceeds even the relaxed upper bound
structural_capacity_review.interpretation: A relaxed bound below the threshold proves impossibility. A bound above it does not prove economic reachability or appropriate difficulty.

invariants: All5100 identities and exact source schedule match, with source hashes before/after.
The copied source and frozen goals remain unchanged.
Pure score_record is used; Game, extract_metrics and make_goals are not called.
All original official scores and archived targets views reproduce within tolerance.
An independent auditor recomputes raw formulas before the legacy overwrite.
Reserve, utilization, wellbeing and trade are identical across views.
Total view changes equal economic-growth plus capacity changes.
Finite bounded scores, original-six only, additional-three None.
No non-score economic input field is mutated; compact replay inputs retain source identity and hashes.
reporting: Do not treat lower caps, narrower spreads or more even top-score counts alone as fairness.
Do not equate 122400 derived country-view results with new games or independent samples.
No new objective coefficients will be fitted to these results.
Show candidate choices separately from approved game rules.
Learning, three human players, 80-minute pacing and score-aware strategy response remain untested.
stop_rule: Complete the declared score replay, structural opportunity audit, independent formula/data checks and concise report-number QA; then package and deliver without optional new games, targets or curve tuning.
